# Motion-aware control037 and ball-gap development

037 extends296features to416 with ball/player relative velocity, short-horizon interception geometry, ball-turn/acceleration proximity, player acceleration and past/future multiscale supports. These are geometric contact proxies, not verified touches. Stationary-ball headings are explicitly undefined and masked. No player identities or labels enter the features. The original prefix is exact and team permutation symmetry is tested. Training retains032's100trees, four conditions, known-live sample schedule, spell weights and seed132; only features change.
